escena: SCENE (cinematic still, an Efeonce studio at blue hour, quiet and calm, thin haze, warm-neutral skin tones but a cool frame): Sophia, wearing the EFEONCE SOFTSHELL JACKET, sits relaxed in a deep dark leather reading chair, framed from the waist up, camera about two meters away at chest height, 85mm. MOMENT: a calm, absorbed reading moment — she holds a thick printed guide open with both hands at chest height, one thumb holding the right page as she is about to turn it; the open pages glow with a soft azure-blue (#0375DB) light from within, as if the ideas on the page were lit, and that glow is the key light of the scene: it lights her face, chin and glasses from below and in front, with a small azure reflection in the lenses of her glasses; she reads with a quiet, concentrated, closed-mouth half smile, eyes on the page, not at the lens. The pages show only soft blurred lines of light, no readable text; the hardcover is plain deep navy cloth with no text and no logo. No laptops, no phones, no tablets, no screens, no mugs, no plants, no other books, no readable text anywhere, no logos of any other brand. Her chair and body sit at about 65 % of the frame width. COMPOSITION FOR A WEBSITE MENU (native to its frame): this horizontal photo is shown small, about 440 pixels wide, inside a dropdown panel; so ONE clear subject — her face lit by the glowing open guide — reads instantly at that size, sits in the RIGHT half, and the left part is calm continuation of the same scene with soft blue bokeh.
